\[
f \bullet B = (f \oplus B) \ominus B
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(f\): The image
- \(B\): The structuring element

Dilation fills every dark detail the element does not fit into, and erosion brings the objects back to their size. Erosion takes the smallest value of f(p + z) for z in B. Dilation takes the largest value of f(p - z), which uses the element turned by 180 degrees. Both match the grayscale erosion and dilation of SciPy. On an image of 0 and 255 they are binary erosion and dilation.
